name: talk_send
description: Send a message to another session's talk inbox. The message is stored in the peer's inbox file (never rewrites the peer's database) and appears in the recipient's next turn; inactive sessions see it on resume. Optional room tags the message for a multi-session discussion and records it in the sender-side room log.

message.description: Message body (max 8000 chars). Quoted as peer content on delivery, not a user instruction.

room.description: Optional discussion room name (max 64 chars); also recorded in the sender-side room log.
